sources.name: EDHREC — Zimone, Infinite Analyst commander page (top synergy + X-cost staples)

guideContent.strategyOverview:
Zimone, Infinite Analyst is a {1}{G}{U} legendary Human Wizard whose two-line ability turns this deck into an X-cost engine. Each turn, the FIRST spell you cast with {X} in its mana cost: (a) costs {1} less per +1/+1 counter on Zimone, and (b) puts two +1/+1 counters on Zimone after it resolves. The discount and the growth both scale off Zimone, so the second X spell of the game is meaningfully cheaper than the first, the third cheaper than the second, and the engine compounds until a Genesis Wave, Stroke of Genius, or Doppelgang ends a game in one shot.

The shell is built around three layers.

Layer 1 — load Zimone fast. Eight ramp pieces (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Simic Signet, Birds of Paradise, Llanowar Elves, Sakura-Tribe Elder, Nature's Lore / Three Visits, Cultivate / Kodama's Reach) land Zimone on T3 reliably. Troyan, Gutsy Explorer adds a dedicated 'spend only on X-spells or MV5+' mana faucet; Elementalist's Palette stores colorless mana earmarked for X-costs after the first big cast.

Layer 2 — feed cheap X spells to start the growth loop. Hangarback Walker, Stonecoil Serpent, Walking Ballista, Goldvein Hydra, and Wildwood Scourge are T2–T4 X-castables that stick a body, grow Zimone by +2/+2, and discount the NEXT X spell that turn (Zimone's first-of-turn ability resets every turn, so each turn you cast both a fuel X-spell early and a payoff X-spell late). Repulsive Mutation doubles as 'counter their spell + put X counters on Zimone' — every counter on Zimone is another {1} off the next X cast.

Layer 3 — multiplier engines and X-spell payoffs. Unbound Flourishing is the deck's single most important card: it doubles X on every permanent X-spell you cast (Hydroid Krasis hits the board twice the size; Primordial Hydra enters at 2X; Wan Shi Tong, Librarian draws 2X) AND copies every X-cost instant/sorcery (Stroke of Genius, Blue Sun's Zenith, Mathemagics, Doppelgang). Owlin Spiralmancer copies the first X spell each turn for the cost of one card slot — Genesis Wave for X=10 twice is usually lethal. Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider doubles the counters Zimone gains, so a single X-spell jumps her +4/+4 instead of +2/+2 and the discount tier accelerates. Geometer's Arthropod, Paradox Surveyor, and Brass Infiniscope turn X-spell casts into loot/tutor/draw triggers, smoothing out the build-around dependency.

Win lines:
  1. Genesis Wave for X≥10 (often ≥18 with Unbound Flourishing or Doubling-style mana) drops the deck on the board: Primordial Hydra, Vorinclex, Beast Whisperer, Birds, Llanowar, signets, plus 4–6 lands.
  2. Finale of Devastation for X≥10 plus Walking Ballista already in play: tutor Craterhoof-class? — no, this deck runs without Craterhoof; instead Finale fetches a second Primordial Hydra or Genesis Hydra and gives the team haste for an alpha strike.
  3. Doppelgang on three permanents with X=4 (12 mana total, often 6 mana from Zimone discount + Troyan + Palette): copy Zimone three times for triple-discount engine, or copy Vorinclex + Unbound Flourishing + Primordial Hydra for a one-shot board.
  4. Stroke of Genius / Blue Sun's Zenith / Mathemagics for lethal mill or draw-out — Mathemagics scales 2^X so X=6 draws 64 cards, deck-cycle into Thassa-style closer if needed (currently the deck wins via board state, not deck-mill).

Bracket target: bracket 3, 2 Game Changers (Rhystic Study + Cyclonic Rift). The deck is intentionally fair: no fast mana beyond Sol Ring, no infinite combos, no tutors, no Thoracle. Brewing status until playtesting confirms the discount engine is reliable enough to scale to B3+. Likely refinements after first reps: trim 1–2 of the smaller hydras (Hooded / Goldvein) for tutors (Eldritch Evolution, Mystical Tutor) or a Doubling Season-style permanent doubler.

deckCategories.name: Commander Engine
deckCategories.description: Zimone discounts the first X-spell each turn by {1} per +1/+1 counter on her, and gains two counters for every X-spell cast. Snowballs hard once she has 2+ counters.

deckCategories.name: X-Spell Multipliers
deckCategories.description: Double, copy, or accelerate X-spells. Unbound Flourishing is the single highest-impact card in the deck: doubles X for permanents and copies X-cost spells.

deckCategories.name: X-Spell Card Selection
deckCategories.description: Trigger on X-spell casts to dig, tutor, or refill the hand. Geometer's Arthropod loots on every X-spell; Paradox Surveyor tutors an X-spell on ETB; Mind into Matter and Mathemagics ARE X-draw spells.

deckCategories.name: X-Spell Threats — Creatures
deckCategories.description: Cheap-to-big bodies. Hangarback Walker, Stonecoil Serpent, and Walking Ballista double as fuel X-casts AND late-game finishers. Hydras scale linearly with mana available after Zimone's discount.

deckCategories.name: X-Spell Finishers — Sorceries & Instants
deckCategories.description: Game-ending X-spells. Genesis Wave dumps the deck; Doppelgang triples a key permanent; Stroke of Genius mills out or refills.

deckCategories.name: X-Spell Utility & Removal
deckCategories.description: X-cost removal and disruption. Curse of the Swine exiles X creatures; Pest Infestation kills small creatures or makes a wall of bodies; Reshape tutors an artifact at instant-adjacent speed.

deckCategories.name: Ramp
deckCategories.description: Get to Zimone fast and keep loading mana for X-spells after she lands. 12 pieces total — heavy because the deck's payoff is mana-dependent.

deckCategories.name: Card Draw
deckCategories.description: Repeatable card advantage outside of the X-spell payoff engine. Beast Whisperer and Guardian Project fire on every creature cast including the X-cost ones.

deckCategories.name: Interaction
deckCategories.description: Cheap counters and removal to protect Zimone and the engine. Counterspell suite stops opposing board wipes; Beast Within / Rapid Hybridization handle resolved threats.

deckCategories.name: Protection & Recursion
deckCategories.description: Keep Zimone alive; recur a key X-spell from the yard. Lightning Greaves makes Zimone uncounterable to removal; Auroral Procession rebuys Genesis Wave or Doppelgang.

synergies.title: Zimone + Unbound Flourishing — discount-and-double X engine
synergies.description: Zimone discounts the first X-spell each turn by {1} per counter on her. Unbound Flourishing doubles X on permanent X-spells and copies X-cost instants and sorceries. Cast Hydroid Krasis for X=6 with Zimone at 4 counters: pay only {2}{G}{U}, get a 12/12 with trample that drew 12 cards. Cast Stroke of Genius for X=4: copy the spell, hit two different opponents (or yourself), draw 8 total off 4 mana of X.

synergies.title: Zimone + Vorinclex — double-stacked counter growth
synergies.description: Vorinclex doubles the +1/+1 counters Zimone gains when an X-spell is cast (two → four). After one X-spell Zimone discounts by {4} instead of {2}; after two, by {8} instead of {4}. Vorinclex also halves opponents' counter gains across the table, soft-locking proliferate decks.

synergies.title: Owlin Spiralmancer + Genesis Wave — double the Wave
synergies.description: Owlin Spiralmancer copies the first X-spell you cast each turn. Genesis Wave for X=10 reveals the top 10, puts all permanents into play; copy reveals another 10 (no overlap — the original 10 are no longer on top), puts those into play too. Resolves into 12–16 permanents on average — close to the entire deck.

synergies.title: Troyan + Elementalist's Palette — colorless mana stockpile for X
synergies.description: Troyan taps for {G}{U} spendable only on MV5+ or {X} spells. Elementalist's Palette gains a charge counter every X-spell cast and taps for {C} per charge — but only for X-spell costs. Combined they fund a 'mana floor' for the deck's payoff without bloating the actual mana base; with 4 charges on Palette plus Troyan's {G}{U}, you can cast a {X}{G}{U} spell for X=6 off five lands.

synergies.title: Repulsive Mutation — counter their spell, grow Zimone
synergies.description: Put X +1/+1 counters on a target creature you control (Zimone is the obvious target), then counter a spell unless its controller pays mana equal to the greatest power on your side. Counts as Zimone's first X-spell — gives her two MORE counters on top of the X you just placed. Repulsive Mutation for X=3 with Zimone at 4 counters: Zimone goes to 9 (4 + 3 + 2), discount on next X-spell jumps to {9}.

synergies.title: Primo, the Unbounded — Zimone-fed fractal token factory
synergies.description: Primo enters with twice-X +1/+1 counters and creates a Fractal token whenever a 0-power creature deals combat damage to a player. Zimone has base power 0, so every combat she connects spawns a Fractal counter-token sized to the damage dealt. Hexproof / trample via Unbound-doubled Primo + Lightning Greaves = ~12+ damage swing per turn from Zimone alone.

synergies.title: Mathemagics + Unbound Flourishing — exponential X-draw
synergies.description: Mathemagics draws 2^X cards. Unbound Flourishing copies it (mana cost contains X). One cast for X=4 = 16 cards drawn; the copy = another 16. 32 cards in hand off {4}{4}{U}{U}, discounted further by Zimone. Refuels the entire deck for a Genesis Wave finisher next turn.

synergies.title: Mind into Matter — draw X, cheat permanent
synergies.description: Draw X cards, then put a permanent of mana value ≤ X from your hand into play tapped. Cast for X=6 with Zimone discounting: draw 6, cheat Primordial Hydra / Vorinclex / Unbound Flourishing / Wan Shi Tong directly onto the battlefield bypassing its mana cost.

synergies.title: Auroral Procession — rebuy a finisher
synergies.description: Auroral Procession is a {G}{U} instant that returns any card from your graveyard to your hand. Recurs the X-spell that won't stay in the yard: Genesis Wave for a second alpha, Doppelgang for a second triple-copy, or Stroke of Genius to mill out the last opponent.

winConditions.title: Genesis Wave for lethal board
winConditions.description: Cast Genesis Wave for X≥10 with Unbound Flourishing in play — doubles to X=20. Dumps roughly a third of the deck onto the battlefield: every Hydra, Vorinclex, Beast Whisperer, every ramp piece. Triggers chain (Beast Whisperer draws per creature, Hydroid Krasis draws + lifegains, Walking Ballista is a 10/10).

winConditions.title: Doppelgang triple-copy lock
winConditions.description: Doppelgang for X=3 with Unbound Flourishing → X=6 effective. Pick three permanents (Vorinclex + Unbound Flourishing + Primordial Hydra) and create six copies of each. 18 permanents at once, including 6 Vorinclex doubling all future counter gains and 6 Hydras as the kill condition.

winConditions.title: Walking Ballista + Vorinclex sniper
winConditions.description: Cast Walking Ballista for X=4 with Vorinclex out — enters with 8 counters (doubled). Each subsequent X-spell cast adds Vorinclex-doubled counters to Zimone, snowballing the discount on the next X-cast. Ballista pings down planeswalkers, small creatures, and players incrementally.

winConditions.title: Stroke of Genius mill-out
winConditions.description: Target opponent with Stroke of Genius for X=their library size with Unbound Flourishing in play (cost halves the X requirement). They draw all their cards; copy targets a second opponent. Backup plan when the board state is too entrenched for combat.
